title: ESMA Market Report: Costs and Performance of EU Retail Investment Products 2023
notes: ESMA (EU supervisor, sells nothing). Bias: investor-protection mandate feeding the PRIIPs/Retail Investment Strategy agenda, so findings stressing high costs and active underperformance fit its policy line. December 2023 edition, data 2013-2022; ESMA brought the cycle forward, so report year is not publication year.
